rows.Origin:
Bred by W. Kordes & Sons (Germany, 1999).
Introduced in Japan by Keisei Rose Nurseries Inc. as 'Pashmina'.
Introduced in United States by Newflora™ LLC as 'Pompon Veranda'.
Introduced in Germany by W. Kordes' Söhne (Wholesale) in 2007 as 'Pompon Flower Circus'.
Introduced in Germany by W. Kordes' Söhne (Retail) in 2010 as 'Pashmina'.
rows.Class: Florists Rose, Hybrid Tea, Patio. (Series: Flower Circus® Collection)
rows.Bloom: Cream and light pink, light pink center. up to 50 petals. Average diameter 1.75". Small to medium, very full (41+ petals), cluster-flowered, cupped bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b and warmer. Can be used for beds and borders, container rose, cut flower or exhibition. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that. Can be grown in the ground or in a container (container requires winter protection).
